sponsored.t: Extends the time for New York city marshals to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs with respect to the execution of money judgments
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to authorizing New York city marshals to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs with respect to the execution of money judgments of the supreme and family courts of the city of New York; extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring New York city marshals to post and electronically file notices of eviction.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions related to the assessment and review of assessments in the county of Nassau
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions related to the assessment and review of assessments in the county of Nassau to June 30, 2028.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Glen Cove to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a hotel and motel tax in the city of Glen Cove, in the county of Nassau, at a rate of four percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to assessing a separate tax on compensation payments received from certain federal programs, settlement funds, reimbursements and pardon-related compensation initiatives
sponsored.sum: Establishes the public harm mitigation fund, consisting of a tax assessment on payments received from a compensation program, settlement fund or reimbursement program, to support victims, fund security measures and provide educational programming relating to the January 6th events at the U.S. Capitol and the importance of constitutional governance and democratic institutions.

sponsored.t: Relates to pilotage fees on vessels transiting the New York state waters of Long Island Sound or Block Island Sound east of Execution Rocks or Sands Point
sponsored.sum: Establishes a new system of pilotage fees for the Long Island Sound and Block Island Sound east of Execution Rocks or Sands Point.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic filing for the court of appeals
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the court of appeals to promulgate rules authorizing the use of electronic means for civil and criminal matters in such court.

sponsored.t: Relates to civil penalties for certain fraud or misrepresentation of a material fact with respect to a financial product or service
sponsored.sum: Relates to civil penalties for certain fraud or misrepresentation of a material fact with respect to a financial product or service.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a veteran suicide mortality review board
sponsored.sum: Establishes a 13 member veteran suicide mortality review board to serve as the statewide entity responsible for the multidisciplinary review of suicide deaths among veterans by identifying trends and systemic factors contributing to veteran suicide; assessing gaps in services, access to care, and institutional practices; developing evidence-based recommendations for prevention and policy improvement; and promoting collaboration among relevant state, local, and federal agencies.

sponsored.t: Provides for electronic notice for collateral loan brokers
sponsored.sum: Provides for notice of intention to sell and notice of surplus to be made by e-mail or text message.

sponsored.t: Relates to arbitration proceedings
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions of law governing arbitration proceedings; specifies fees and expenses with regard to employment or consumer arbitration proceedings; directs certain sanctions on a party which breaches an arbitration agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the duration of mechanic's liens
sponsored.sum: Provides for the continuation of a mechanic's lien which has been discharged by undertaking for a period of three years from the commencement of a foreclosure action.

sponsored.t: Relates to base proportions in assessing units in Nassau and Suffolk counties
sponsored.sum: Limits the amount of property tax shift between homestead/non-homestead and class share apportionment for local governments within and including Nassau and Suffolk County.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for endodontic services
sponsored.sum: Mandates insurance policies which cover restorative dental services to provide coverage for endodontic services including exams, imaging, root canals and post-treatment care.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for bruxism diagnosis and treatment
sponsored.sum: Requires policies which provide dental coverage to provide coverage for bruxism diagnosis and treatment, including the cost of occlusal guards; requires medicaid and HMO coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to notices of non-renewal provided to a health care professional by a health care plan
sponsored.sum: Provides that notices of non-renewal provided by a health care plan to a health care professional shall include an explanation of the reasons for such non-renewal and information for the health care professional to respond to such determination.

sponsored.t: Designates an individual who has been convicted of certain crimes or of certain offenses involving sports contests, horse races or wagering thereon, as a prohibited sports bettor
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Designates an individual found to have been convicted of certain crimes where the complainant or victim is an amateur or professional athlete, coach, official or other participant in a sports event, or a jockey, driver, trainer, owner, official or other participant in a horse race, or to have been convicted of certain offenses involving sports contests, horse races, or wagering thereon, as a prohibited sports bettor; requires the commission to notify the individual; allows for the individual to contest such designation; requires account wagering licensees to prohibit any individual designated as a prohibited sports bettor from establishing or maintaining a wagering account.

sponsored.t: Relates to extreme risk protection orders
sponsored.sum: Relates to extreme risk protection orders; defines "exception"; authorizes a police officer or district attorney to file an application for an extreme risk protection order if found that a person meets the requirements of an exception pursuant to section 6340 of the civil practice law and rules; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to guardians of persons who are intellectually and developmentally disabled; and repeals certain provisions of the surrogate's court procedure act relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to guardians of persons who are intellectually and developmentally disabled; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act to establish the statewide initiative of not-for-profit guardians.

sponsored.t: Relates to ensuring the privacy of name change actions and of sex designation change actions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of court administration, clerks, and all other records custodians to develop policies and procedures to ensure no identifying information or documentation relating to name change actions or sex designation change actions is visible or retrievable in any electronic database maintained by the state of New York or a subdivision thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to joint spousal and non-spousal accounts and convenience accounts
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions for the establishment and administration of joint accounts and non-survivorship accounts; provides for account agreements, payments during lifetime, and liability; provides for notice, competing claims, and court orders; defines terms; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Directs the chief administrator of the courts to develop and implement a random audit compliance program to conduct periodic financial audits of law firms; and provides for funding of the program
sponsored.sum: Directs the chief administrator of the courts to develop and implement a random audit compliance program to conduct periodic financial audits of law firms that engage in the private practice and create and manage escrow trust accounts in the state in order to ensure proper handling of IOLTA accounts; provides for the funding of the random audit compliance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to displaying a flag and plaque in the capitol for raising awareness of veteran suicide
sponsored.sum: Provides that space be set aside in the capitol for the display of the Veteran Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Flag and plaque for the raising of awareness of veteran suicide; directs the commissioner of general services to place and maintain such flag and plaque.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the use of nondisclosure agreements to prevent disclosure of information relating to environmental and health impacts of certain infrastructure and energy development projects
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use and enforcement of nondisclosure agreements and confidentiality agreements that prevent any person from discussing matters of public concern related to large-scale infrastructure and energy development projects.

sponsored.t: Prohibits parties to mediation or dispute resolution from recording such proceedings without the consent of all parties
sponsored.sum: Establishes an all-party consent requirement for any audio or video recording of mediation and court-annexed alternative dispute resolution proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to pre-release briefings for incarcerated veterans regarding available federal and state benefits
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of veterans' services to conduct pre-release briefings for incarcerated veterans regarding available federal and state benefits available to veterans and their families and how to apply for such benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjournments in contemplation of dismissal and suspended judgments in child protective proceedings in the family court
sponsored.sum: Relates to adjournments in contemplation of dismissal and suspended judgments in child protective proceedings in the family court.

sponsored.t: Modernizes, improves fairness, efficiency, transparency, and reduces costs in civil justice procedures; repealer
sponsored.sum: Modernizes, improves fairness, efficiency, transparency, and reduces costs in civil justice procedures; clarifies disclosure and discovery procedures to further protect litigants' rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions or proceedings involving section one of article nineteen of the state constitution
sponsored.sum: Sets the required venue for actions or proceedings involving section one of article nineteen of the state constitution.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the mortgagee or lienor of an abandoned multiple dwelling to apply for the appointment of a receiver to bring the building into compliance
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the mortgagee or lienor of an abandoned multiple dwelling to apply for the appointment of a receiver to bring the building into compliance.

sponsored.t: Increases the marriage ceremony fee and the marriage license fee in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Increases the marriage ceremony fee to fifty-five dollars and the marriage license fee to sixty dollars in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to state financial aid for library social work services
sponsored.sum: Creates a program to award state financial aid for social work services to be provided in libraries located in economically disadvantaged communities to enhance and expand access to services in places where individuals seek assistance and resources.

sponsored.t: Authorizes school districts to borrow against certain reserve funds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes school districts to borrow against certain reserve funds, pursuant to a resolution adopted by the board of education of such school district.

sponsored.t: Prevents fraudulent deed transfers
sponsored.sum: Relates to preventing fraudulent deed transfers; protects home owners from being misled into transferring their home to mortgage servicers.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting recordkeeping and reporting duties of public notaries
sponsored.sum: Limits recordkeeping and reporting duties of public notaries to electronic notarization acts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of telematics systems by automobile insurers
sponsored.sum: Requires certain disclosures by automobile insurers relating to the use of telematics systems in determining insurance rates and/or discounts.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting admission of spontaneous statements by victims of certain offenses who are elderly, physically disabled, incompetent or determined to be incapacitated
sponsored.sum: Permits admission of spontaneous statements by victims of certain frauds, abuse and theft offenses, who are a vulnerable elderly person, an incompetent or physically disabled person, or a person who has been determined to be incapacitated.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing legally sufficient evidence in certain crimes against a vulnerable elderly, physically disabled, incompetent or incapacitated person
sponsored.sum: Establishes a reasonable inference that certain transfers of money or property by a vulnerable elderly, physically disabled, incompetent or incapacitated person were a wrongful taking in violation larceny statutes.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the sale of a court transcript by any person other than a stenographer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of a court transcript by any person other than a stenographer.

sponsored.t: Grants temporary parking permits for handicapped parking spaces to pregnant persons
sponsored.sum: Grants temporary parking permits for handicapped parking spaces to pregnant persons; requires certification from a physician; provides that such permit terminates at the end of the pregnancy.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring venues of public accommodation to maintain accessible parking in accordance with federal law
sponsored.sum: Requires venues of public accommodation to maintain accessible parking in accordance with federal law; establishes penalties and enforcement mechanisms for the division of human rights and local governments.

sponsored.t: Grants the legislature to have an equal role with the governor in the budget process
sponsored.sum: Provides that the Governor's annual budget proposal to the Legislature shall include statements of any new legislation, amendment to legislation, or limitation on the effect of any legislation contained in the budget; makes related provisions granting the legislature an equal role with the governor in the budget process.

sponsored.t: Renames the supreme court the superior court and the court of appeals the supreme court
sponsored.sum: Renames the supreme court the superior court and the court of appeals the supreme court.

sponsored.t: Establishes disclosure requirements for AI-generated or materially AI-altered media depicting historically recognized human disasters when such media is publicly distributed
sponsored.sum: Establishes disclosure requirements for AI-generated or materially AI-altered media depicting historically recognized human disasters when such media is publicly distributed; requires platform operators to allow the use of labelling; provides for enforcement by the attorney general.

sponsored.t: Relates to what qualifies as an applicable, timely and relevant issue for no fault separation
sponsored.sum: Relates to what qualifies as an applicable, timely and relevant issue for no fault separation.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting provisions for the execution of electronic wills
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions for the execution of electronic wills including attestation, revocation, filing and storage; requires the chief administrator of the courts to adopt rules necessary and appropriate for electronic wills.

sponsored.t: Repeals the criminal fortune telling statute; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to the criminal fortune telling statute.

sponsored.t: Establishes a deaf and hard of hearing outreach program to facilitate communication between hearing-impaired persons and law enforcement personnel
sponsored.sum: Establishes a deaf and hard of hearing outreach program to facilitate communication between deaf and hard of hearing individuals and law enforcement personnel.

sponsored.t: Establishes a 10 day waiting period for the purchase of any firearm
sponsored.sum: Establishes a 10 day waiting period for the purchase of any firearm; establishes violations of such provisions shall constitute a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal possession of a flamethrower
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of criminal possession of a flamethrower as a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to including the basis of religious attire and facial hair in the definition of unlawful discriminatory practice
sponsored.sum: Relates to including the basis of religious attire and facial hair in the definition of unlawful discriminatory practice.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for medically necessary hearing aids purchased from hearing aid dispensers
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for medically necessary hearing aids purchased from hearing aid dispensers.

sponsored.t: Requires the development of a training program to educate first responders on effective communication with deaf and hard of hearing individuals in emergency situations
sponsored.sum: Requires the state interagency coordinating council for services to persons who are deaf, deaf-blind, or hard of hearing to develop and implement a training program to educate first responders on effective communication with deaf and hard of hearing individuals in emergency situations.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to from two dollars to five dollars.

sponsored.t: Limits the lookback period for insurance overpayment recovery from health care providers to twelve months
sponsored.sum: Changes the lookback period for insurance overpayment recovery from health care providers from twenty-four months to twelve months.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of banning books by publicly funded libraries
sponsored.sum: Provides that publicly funded libraries may not ban books because of partisan or doctrinal disapproval; directs school districts to adopt the ALA library bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Establishes a county of Nassau deer management pilot program; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes a county of Nassau deer management pilot program; requires a report; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to proving lost or destroyed lifetime trusts
sponsored.sum: Provides a mechanism for establishing the existence of a writing creating or amending a lifetime trust which was either lost or destroyed.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain emergency response vehicles to be equipped with appropriate communication devices for deaf individuals
sponsored.sum: Requires police vehicles, fire vehicles, ambulances and emergency ambulance service vehicles to be equipped with appropriate communication devices to facilitate real-time communication with deaf individuals.

sponsored.t: Prohibits deceptive practices and the suppression of voters, and increases penalties for violations of the elective franchise
sponsored.sum: Prohibits deceptive practices and the suppression of voters.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting certain statements relating to sexual abuse or misconduct from disclosure under FOIL
sponsored.sum: Exempts statements of victims and witnesses relating to sexual abuse or misconduct from disclosure under FOIL provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the crime of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of domestic violence punishable as a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: In relation to enrollment eligibility for election officials in the address confidentiality program
sponsored.sum: Permits enrollment in the address confidentiality program for election officers.

sponsored.t: Requires more specific data reporting by the chief administrator
sponsored.sum: Requires more specific data reporting by the chief administrator to include information relating to all courts in the unified court system, including town and village courts.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction on the January 6th insurrection at the U.S. capitol
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction on the January 6th insurrection at the U.S. capitol and its aftermath in all schools in the state.

sponsored.t: Includes community centers with a religious affiliation in the definition of public place for purposes of offenses against public order
sponsored.sum: Includes community centers with a religious affiliation in the definition of public place for purposes of offenses against public order; includes falsely reporting an incident and placing a false bomb or hazardous substance in the definition of specified offense for the purposes of hate crimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to purchasing restrictions on persons boycotting Israel and the investment of certain public funds in companies boycotting Israel
sponsored.sum: Relates to purchasing restrictions on persons boycotting Israel and the investment of certain public funds in companies boycotting Israel; requires the commissioner of general services to compile a list of companies boycotting Israel; establishes that such companies will be considered non-responsive bidders.

sponsored.t: Relates to comparing fingerprints of a defendant against the statewide database
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a court to order the division of criminal justice services to compare fingerprints of the defendant against the statewide database.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"; regulates the submission and determinations of applications for ownership of cooperative apartments.

sponsored.t: Enacts the election workers and polling places protection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "election workers and polling places protection act" to protect poll watchers, election officials, voters and physical property being used as a polling place or by the board of elections.

sponsored.t: Prohibits recording of the entrance of a school ground
sponsored.sum: Prohibits recording of the entrance or exit of a school ground or the entrance or exit to a property that contains school grounds within its boundaries.

sponsored.t: Relates to giving and/or receiving unlawful benefits
sponsored.sum: Makes it a felony to give or receive unlawful benefits in excess of $3000.

sponsored.t: Relates to background clearances for temporary child care employment agencies and child care educational and training institutions
sponsored.sum: Includes temporary child care employment agencies and child care educational and training institutions as providers authorized to conduct background clearances.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification of crime victims of the death of the accused
sponsored.sum: Requires the notification of a crime victim or witness of the death of the accused if such person dies during pending judicial proceedings or during any period of incarceration, parole or post-release supervision, or when an order of protection exists.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the offense of aggravated reckless driving
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offense of aggravated reckless driving which involves harm to an identifiable person or property; makes such offense bail-eligible.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of related use of a lethal or explosive device
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of related use of a lethal or explosive device; provides for additional 10 years imprisonment for certain crimes where a lethal or explosive device is used; permits exemption from such additional sentence when the defendant provides court with the source of such lethal or explosive device.

sponsored.t: Relates to securing orders for certain firearms offenses
sponsored.sum: Permits courts to remand a principal to the custody of the sheriff for felony offenses involving the possession of firearms and weapons.

sponsored.t: Relates to additional damages recoverable for the use of a deadly weapon
sponsored.sum: Permits additional damages recoverable for the use of a deadly weapon resulting in death.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of campaign funds for any settlement fees, fines or penalties for sexual harassment civil or criminal actions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of campaign funds to pay any settlement fees, fines or penalties for sexual harassment civil or criminal actions.

sponsored.t: Provides that for settlements that require a court order the order shall provide for the payment of interest on the settlement amount at the statutory rate
sponsored.sum: Provides that for settlements that require a court order, the order, or the judgment in a special proceeding, shall provide for the payment of interest on the settlement amount at the statutory interest rate on judgments.

sponsored.t: Requires the petitioner for appointment of a guardian for an incapacitated person to identify all other persons who may be able to manage the affairs of such incapacitated person
sponsored.sum: Requires the petitioner for appointment as the guardian for an incapacitated person to identify all other persons who may be able to manage the affairs of such incapacitated person; prohibits appointment solely for the purposes of bill collection or resolving a bill collection dispute.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders to prohibit settlement agreements which conceal a public hazard or any information that would identify a public hazard.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the application of fail-first or step therapy protocols to coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of serious mental health conditions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the application of fail-first or step therapy protocols to coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of serious mental health conditions; defines serious mental health condition.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain judgments by confession
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the entry of a judgment by confession on amounts due from one or more individuals for personal, family, household, consumer or non-business purposes and on a debt incurred if the principal amount of such debt was less than $5,000,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions upon a subordinate bond or note
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to actions upon a subordinate bond or note; provides a statute of limitations for such actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers and authority of the state commission on judicial conduct
sponsored.sum: Relates to complaints regarding judges and confidentiality of records; extends the jurisdiction of the state commission on judicial conduct as to judges who resign or retire while under investigation or formal charges.

sponsored.t: Relates to a state flag for raising awareness of veteran suicide
sponsored.sum: Provides that the "Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Flag" shall be the official state flag for the raising of awareness of veteran suicide; directs the commissioner of general services to establish a protocol for the flying of such flag.

sponsored.t: Relates to ratifying the proposed amendment to the Constitution of the United States relating to the labor of persons under eighteen years of age
sponsored.sum: Relates to ratifying the proposed amendment to the Constitution of the United States relating to the labor of persons under eighteen years of age.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of a non-indemnity legal service plan
sponsored.sum: Provides that the sale of a non-indemnity legal service plan shall not constitute doing an insurance business in this state; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to a symbol on a driver's license or state-issued ID card indicating that an individual has a non-apparent disability
sponsored.sum: Allows individuals to apply to display a symbol on their driver's licenses or state-issued ID cards indicating that the individual has a non-apparent disability to assist law enforcement and emergency personnel in providing appropriate support during interactions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "protect our pedestrians (POP) act"
sponsored.sum: Permits villages located in counties with a population between one million and one million five hundred thirty thousand to adopt local laws to implement a demonstration program imposing monetary liability not to exceed fifty dollars on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator to comply with stop signs; permits such villages to install and operate stop sign photo violation monitoring systems as part of such demonstration program.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring disclosure of use of generative artificial intelligence in a civil action
sponsored.sum: Requires certification of filings produced using generative artificial intelligence; requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative artificial intelligence in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enforcement of liens on personal property at self-storage facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the enforcement of liens on personal property at self-storage facilities; requires enforcement of a lien by public sale; requires a delay in enforcement of a lien if the tenant is a service member who is transferred or deployed on active duty or if the tenant is deceased; requires 60 days notice if the property subject to the lien is a motor vehicle or watercraft; requires a storage facility to hold certain surplus funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to the discount rate for structured judgments in medical malpractice actions
sponsored.sum: Changes the discount rate for structured judgments in medical malpractice actions.

sponsored.t: Clarifies that pretrial motions in limine are not required in order for deposition testimony to be introduced at trial
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that pretrial motions in limine are not required in order for deposition testimony to be introduced at trial.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain health care decisions for persons with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Extends the provisions of the family health care decisions act in the public health law to health care decisions for patients with intellectual or developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for state legislators in the address confidentiality program
sponsored.sum: Permits enrollment in the address confidentiality program for members of the state legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to the maintenance of certain sidewalks within a town
sponsored.sum: Provides that a town may not direct abutting property owners to maintain sidewalks which abut county highways or which are not directly accessible from such owner's property.

sponsored.t: Relates to automatic orders in matrimonial actions
sponsored.sum: Sets the effectiveness and duration of automatic orders in matrimonial actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain records checks in child custody proceedings; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring certain records checks in child custody proceedings involving orders of protection; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting an interpreter to remain with a deaf, hard of hearing or nonverbal patient during admission to a hospital
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to permit an interpreter to remain with a deaf, hard of hearing or nonverbal patient during admission to a hospital until appropriate hospital staff is assigned to interpret.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 42 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 3404-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to treatment of deaf, hard of hearing and nonverbal individuals during admission to a hospital" NOT APPROVED This bill would require the Department of Health to promulgate regu- lations ensuring that all deaf, hard of hearing, and non-verbal individ- uals have access to an interpreter or other authorized helper during their period of admission to a hospital until such time as the hospital provides to the patient a certified interpreter or other qualified person. The Hospital Patient's Bill of Rights already requires hospitals to provide patients with skilled interpreters and persons skilled in commu- nications upon request; obtain information about a patients' need for reasonable accommodations…

sponsored.t: Relates to notice to be provided prior to a foreclosure action by a homeowners' association
sponsored.sum: Requires notice to be provided ninety days prior to commencement of a foreclosure action by a homeowners' association or condominium board to enforce a lien for unpaid common charges, assessments, fines or fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to base proportions in Nassau and Suffolk counties
sponsored.sum: Relates to base proportions in assessing units in Nassau and Suffolk counties for 2025--2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to the display of religious items on dwellings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a property owner from enforcing or adopting a restriction that prohibits one or more religious items from being displayed or affixed on any entry door or entry doorframe of a dwelling.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting provisions for the execution of electronic wills
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions for the execution of electronic wills including attestation, revocation and filing.

sponsored.t: Allows for no fault separation
sponsored.sum: Allows for no fault separation where the relationship between the spouses has broken down irretrievably for a period of at least six months; requires that issues of support and custody or visitation have been resolved.

sponsored.t: Adds medical and health insurance information within the definitions of personal identifying information; repealer
sponsored.sum: Adds medical and health insurance information within the definitions of personal identifying information.

sponsored.t: Relates to protective orders for juries
sponsored.sum: Clarifies certain provisions relating to protective orders for juries.
